name: Tasks
description: Tasks in the Tasks plugin's format: due, scheduled and start dates, priorities and recurrence on checklist lines, tasks queries that gather them from the whole vault, a done date when you tick one, and a form to create or edit one.
author: Vaultite
forAgents: Tasks are `- [ ]` lines with the Tasks plugin's fields (📅 due, ⏳ scheduled, 🔁 recurrence; `vau docs tasks`): find them with `tasks_list` (a Tasks query), add with `tasks_add`, tick with `tasks_complete`.

format.label: Task format
format.description: how dates, priority and recurrence are written on new fields: Tasks' emoji, or Dataview's [due:: 2026-10-08] (both are read)

globalFilter.label: Global filter
globalFilter.description: only checkbox lines with this text are tasks (#task); empty: every one

removeGlobalFilter.label: Hide the global filter
removeGlobalFilter.description: leave the global filter out of task descriptions in query results

globalQuery.label: Global query
globalQuery.description: instructions every query starts with (path does not include Archive); a query with ignore global query leaves them out

doneDate.label: Done date
doneDate.description: write the date a task is ticked done on its line

cancelledDate.label: Cancelled date
cancelledDate.description: write the date a task is cancelled on its line

createdDate.label: Created date
createdDate.description: write the day it was made on tasks from the form and from agents, and on a recurrence's next one

recurrenceBelow.label: Next recurrence below
recurrenceBelow.description: put a recurring task's next occurrence below the done one, not above
